name: EMA Cross Contest Hedged
summary: This EA trades EMA crossover signals with an optional MACD filter, placing a main market order plus 4 hedge pending orders at fixed intervals. It uses trailing stops for open positions and optionally closes opposite positions on signal reversal. The hedging mechanism creates a ladder of stop orders in the direction of the trend to scale into positions.
summary_zh: 该EA基于EMA交叉信号进行交易，可选MACD过滤，入场时同时下1个市价单和4个间隔排列的对冲挂单。对已持仓位使用移动止损跟踪利润，并在信号反转时可选平掉反向仓位。对冲机制通过在趋势方向上布置阶梯式止损挂单来逐步建仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于短期EMA与长期EMA的交叉判断趋势方向，当短EMA上穿长EMA时视为上升趋势，下穿时视为下降趋势。入场条件为EMA交叉且可选MACD过滤（做多需MACD主线>=0，做空需MACD主线<=0），入场时除市价单外还会在距离当前价格1-4倍HedgeLevel处放置4个同方向止损挂单，形成阶梯式加仓。出场条件包括固定止损止盈以及移动止损跟踪，移动止损仅在利润超过TrailingStop+TrailingStep时才启动调整。仓位管理采用固定手数，未根据账户资金动态调整。资金管理方面没有最大持仓限制，4个挂单加上市价单意味着单次信号可能同时持有5个仓位，风险敞口较大。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the crossover of a short-period EMA and a long-period EMA to determine trend direction, with an uptrend signaled when the short EMA crosses above the long EMA and a downtrend when it crosses below. Entry conditions require an EMA crossover plus an optional MACD filter (long requires MACD main line >= 0, short requires MACD main line <= 0), and upon entry the EA places a market order along with 4 stop orders spaced at 1x to 4x the HedgeLevel distance, creating a ladder of scaling-in positions. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, as well as a trailing stop that only activates when unrealized profit exceeds TrailingStop plus TrailingStep. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size with no dynamic adjustment based on account equity or risk percentage. Money management lacks a maximum position limit, and the combination of a market order plus 4 pending stop orders means a single signal can result in up to 5 simultaneous positions, creating significant risk exposure.

pros: 使用EMA交叉结合MACD双重过滤，信号质量优于单一指标
移动止损机制可以锁定浮动利润，减少回撤
挂单有过期时间设置，避免过期信号导致的无效入场
支持3/5位小数点自动调整，兼容不同品种
有成交量合法性检查，防止无效手数下单
pros_en: Uses EMA crossover combined with optional MACD filter for higher signal quality than a single indicator
Trailing stop mechanism locks in floating profits and reduces drawdowns
Pending orders have expiration times, preventing invalid entries from stale signals
Automatic 3/5 digit point adjustment ensures compatibility with different symbol formats
Volume validation check prevents orders with invalid lot sizes
cons: 单次信号可产生5个仓位(1市价+4挂单)，风险敞口过大且无最大持仓控制
移动止损步进仅1点且移动止损仅30点，在波动较大市场中容易被扫出
挂单间隔仅6点过于密集，在剧烈行情中可能快速全部成交导致大量亏损
没有持仓数量检查，不同信号可能累积大量同向仓位
止损140点止盈120点，盈亏比小于1，长期期望值不利
cons_en: A single signal can create 5 positions (1 market + 4 pending), with no maximum position control creating excessive risk exposure
Trailing stop of only 30 pips with 1 pip step is too tight and likely to get stopped out in volatile markets
Hedge level of only 6 pips between pending orders is too dense, all 4 could fill rapidly in fast markets causing large losses
No total position count check means multiple signals can accumulate excessive directional exposure
Stop loss of 140 pips vs take profit of 120 pips gives a risk-reward ratio below 1, which is unfavorable long-term
improvements: 增加最大同时持仓数量限制，防止风险敞口失控
将HedgeLevel与ATR动态挂钩，使挂单间距适应市场波动性
增加盈亏比控制，使止盈至少大于止损或采用动态止盈
improvements_en: Add a maximum simultaneous position count limit to prevent uncontrolled risk exposure
Link HedgeLevel dynamically to ATR so that pending order spacing adapts to market volatility
Improve risk-reward ratio by setting take profit larger than stop loss or using dynamic take profit targets

risk_points: 单次信号最多开5个仓位，无最大仓位限制，风险敞口可能急剧扩大
挂单间距仅6点过于密集，极端行情下可能全部快速成交导致巨额亏损
盈亏比小于1，长期统计学上不利
未检查已有挂单数量，重复信号可能产生更多挂单叠加风险
risk_points_en: Single signal can open up to 5 positions with no maximum position limit, risk exposure can expand rapidly
Pending order spacing of only 6 pips is too dense, all could fill rapidly in extreme markets causing massive losses
Risk-reward ratio below 1 is statistically unfavorable long-term
No check on existing pending orders, repeated signals could stack even more pending orders increasing risk
